title: IndexFeature must be recorded before it can be required
answers: How do I add a new index feature / capability flag for the search index?
Why would requiring a new index feature cause indexes to rebuild forever?
What's the two-step process for rolling out a new index-mapping behavior?
body:
Symptom: a feature added straight to RequiredIndexFeatures would make every pre-existing index (which never recorded it) look permanently out of date, triggering endless rebuilds.
Root cause: IndexFeaturesForNewIndex(false) / currentIndexFeatures only lists what new indexes record; RequiredIndexFeatures(postRankAuthz) checks what an existing index must have to be considered current — these are deliberately separate lists.
Fix pattern: first add the feature to currentIndexFeatures and knownIndexFeatures only (recorded, not required) for one release; add it to RequiredIndexFeatures in a later release once all live indexes have had a chance to be built/rebuilt with it set.
Constraints: applies to any new per-index capability flag in this file; does not apply to features that are purely informational/diagnostic and never enforced as required.
says: How do I add a new feature or capability to search index?
Why does adding a required index feature cause endless rebuilding?
What's the correct rollout sequence for a new index feature?
New search feature requirement immediately breaks all existing indexes
search: New per-index capability flags in pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go must be added to currentIndexFeatures and knownIndexFeatures first (recorded, not required) for one release before being added to RequiredIndexFeatures in a later release. The currentIndexFeatures/IndexFeaturesForNewIndex(false) list defines what new indexes record; RequiredIndexFeatures(postRankAuthz) checks what existing indexes must have to be current—these are deliberately separate to prevent pre-existing indexes without the flag from looking permanently out of date and triggering endless rebuilds. Two-release rollout pattern is mandatory for any new index capability flag in this file; does not apply to purely informational or diagnostic features that are never enforced as required. Applies to IndexFeature list changes in pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:currentIndexFeatures, pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:RequiredIndexFeatures, and pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:IndexFeaturesForNewIndex.
